description: Compares revenue, activation, retention, and review-request outcomes by physical location. Does not expose customer names, invoice rows, or mutation access. Location writes stay on the in-product assistant, not MCP. Use to compare location metrics in the connected business. Returns period_days, locations, summary, scope.

period.description: Number of days for location comparison metrics; defaults to 30.

name: reports-by-location

locations.description: Bounded locations records returned by this tool.

period_days.description: Period days for the returned result.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

summary.description: Summary metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

title: Reports By Location Tool
